description: This file defines the 'Serializer' class responsible for serializing and deserializing PSR-7 RequestInterface instances to and from strings and streams. It includes methods for handling request message parsing, generating request strings, and managing request components like request line and URI.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to serialize and deserialize HTTP request messages to and from strings or streams.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Request object from a raw request message string.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates a Request object from a stream containing a request message.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes a PSR-7 RequestInterface object into a raw HTTP request string.

methods.name: getRequestLine
methods.description: Extracts the request line components (method, target, version) from a stream.

methods.name: createUriFromRequestTarget
methods.description: Creates a Uri object based on the request target string.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Deserialize a request string into a Request object.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Deserialize a stream containing a request message into a Request object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serialize a Request object into a string.

methods.name: getRequestLine
methods.description: Retrieve the request line components from a stream.

methods.name: createUriFromRequestTarget
methods.description: Create a Uri object from the request target string.
